Bibliotecas de terceiros incluídas nesta pasta (servidas pelo próprio site,
sem depender de CDN externo):

  exceljs 4.4.0          MIT          https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs
  pdfmake 0.2.20         MIT          https://github.com/bpampuch/pdfmake
  xlsx (SheetJS) 0.18.5  Apache-2.0   https://github.com/SheetJS/sheetjs   (só para ler .xls antigo)
  shpjs 6.1.0            MIT          https://github.com/calvinmetcalf/shapefile-js  (shapefile .zip)
  proj4 2.15.0           MIT          https://github.com/proj4js/proj4js
  polylabel 2.0.1        ISC          https://github.com/mapbox/polylabel  (com tinyqueue 3.0.0, ISC)
